story: Ryan Smoker and Ryan Martin, who also own the Lancaster branding firm Infantree (established 2010), announced Ellicott and Company in August 2015 as an American-made men's boutique working with craftsmen, especially in Lancaster, with e-commerce launching ahead of a physical store. The shop opened in 2016 at 45 North Market Street in downtown Lancaster; Smoker and Martin were college roommates who grew up in Lancaster, and the idea followed a visit to Imogene + Willie in Nashville. In March 2022 the shop removed walls to add about 500 square feet, bringing retail space to about 2,000 square feet, with more camping, hiking and fly-fishing goods. Its site lists 104 brands, among them its own label Ellicott & Co., which is sold as shirts, tees, grooming, decor and stationery and is described as built "in collaboration with makers".
